Course Project Videos

Ultrasonic Distance Measurement System

Dhanush Krishna R N, Pranav S

This project is a distance measurement system built using an 8051 microcontroller and an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor. It calculates the distance to an object in real-time, displays it on a 16x2 LCD, and sounds a buzzer alarm if the object gets closer than 15 cm

8051 based soil moisture monitoring and landslide early warning system

Abhimanyu P Nair, Sam B Cletus

Our project is a landslide detection system using the AT89S52 that monitors soil moisture levels to identify potential landslide conditions. When the moisture exceeds a set threshold, the system alerts users through a buzzer and displays warning messages on a 16x2 LCD Display.

Smart blind stick

Akshay V nair , Nasir Ali

Our project is a smart blindstick that is made with at89s52 microcontroller and an ultrasonic sensor.it detects the distance between the sensor and an object and display it on the lcd, while the buzzer will activate after a particular range

Current Overload detection

Ujjwal Skandakumar P, Vysakh P Chandran

It is a project demonstrating the detection of current overload in an electric component. We have used motor as the component and led as an indicator for current overload

Batch26_currentoverloaddetection

Vysakh P Chandran, Ujjwal Skandakumar P

Current overload detection in load using current sensor. For demonstration of working we used a dc motor as load where current sensor reads the load current and when the value exceeds the limit, the indicator turns on.

Security System using 8051 with Siren alert and LCD display monitoring.

Abhilash A, Febin Eldhose

This project uses an 8051 microcontroller to detect motion through a PIR sensor and display the status of motion on an LCD in real time. When motion is detected, a buzzer is activated and a message is shown, while no motion keeps the system silent with an updated display.

Home Automation System using 8051 microcontroller using blue-tooth module

Mohamed Hanoof, Nawrah Baramy

An implementation of home automation system using the HC-05 blue-tooth module integrated with Serial Bluetooth Terminal App with a 5v fan and LED as the devices under control

PASSWORD BASED CIRCUIT BREAKER

KR ASLAM RASHEED, AMAN ABDURAHMAN

Our project will helps to digitalise the menu system in household electric meter box with a password security and menu system

Smart Irrigation System

Ann Joy, Joseph Jophy

This project is a soil moisture monitoring system using an 8051 microcontroller that detects the moisture level in soil through a sensor and comparator circuit. Based on the detected level, it displays the soil condition on an LCD and indicates whether watering is required using an LED.

SPEED DETECTOR USING 8051

Abhiroop V,Sreehari M S

Design and implementation of a vehicle speed detection system using the 8051 microcontroller and IR sensors, featuring integrated overspeed detection, real-time speed display, and visual alert mechanisms.

DHT 11 Powered Humidity Sensor

Abhin Raj M, Adithya Narayanan, Asish T P

Humidity sensor powered by DHT11 sensor, which shows output in a 16x2 LCD screen. Shows current hunidity, minimum record and maximum record values along with average humidity across 4 samples.

Fire Alarm

Devitheertha T P, Lakshmi Manoj

Our project is an automated fire detection system that uses an 8051 microcontroller to monitor an IR-based flame sensor for the presence of fire. When a flame is detected, the controller triggers a BC547 transistor to drive a piezo buzzer, providing an immediate audible alert for emergency safety.

Frequency counter

Mathew SN (72) , Rahul.V (73)

This project focuses on the design and implementation of a frequency counter using the 8051-microcontroller architecture. The core of the project is 8051’s internal Timer/Counter modules to measure the frequency of an external periodic signal and interfacing the microcontroller with an external display to monitor real time signal data

8051 Microcontroller Based ADC Interfacing to Measure Analog Voltage Using Potentiometer and LCD Display

Jaiden J L Gil, Dhananjayan M

Project aims to interface an ADC0804 converter to read analog signals from a 10k potentiometer and to realize a real-time digital voltmeter system on a common board.It displays calculated voltage and raw 8-bit digital data on a 16x2 LCD.

HEART RATE MONITOR SYSTEM

HASIL ALI P T, MARK JOHNY

This project is a digital heart rate monitor that uses an optical SR011 sensor to detect your pulse as an analog signal. An ADC0804 chip translates this continuous wave into digital data so the 8051 microcontroller can understand and process it. Finally, the microcontroller calculates your Beats Per Minute (BPM) and displays the real-time result on a 16x2 LCD screen.

PASSWORD BASED DOOR LOCK WITH SECURITY ALERT

ROHANN SUBHASH, RIYA ANNA THOMAS

door lock sytem based of 4x4 matrix keypad which has an lcd segment for user interface. additionally, a buzzer for system locked conditon and automatic door closing after 5s if door is opened.

PASSWORD BASED DOOR LOCK WITH SECURITY ALERT

ROHANN SUBHASH, RIYA ANNA THOMAS

Door lock system based on 4x4 matrix keypad with lcd display for uder feedback, buzzer for system locked condition and automatic door closing after 5s.

BIDIRECTIONAL VISITOR COUNTER WITH ENERGY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM

Malavika K , Aelina Anish

The project accurately counts room entries and exits to determine and display the current occupancy, while effectively ignoring incomplete or invalid trigger events. Additionally, an SMD indicator is activated whenever at least one person is present inside the room.

4 way traffic light controller using 8051

JIBIN P, Sivamohan

This project uses an 8051 microcontroller to control traffic lights at a four-way intersection by automatically switching between red, yellow, and green signals in a fixed sequence. It ensures smooth and organized traffic flow by giving each direction a timed turn while the others remain stopped.

DC Motor Interface for Speed and Direction Control using 8051

Devendranath Sagar C, Avanthika T V

This project demonstrates the interfacing of a DC motor with the 8051 microcontroller to control its speed and direction.

Contactless Digital Tachometer

Muhammad Shamnad N, Devananda R

The Contactless Digital Tachometer is an 8051 based system that measures a motor's rotational speed using an IR sensor to detect revolutions without physical friction. It utilizes Pulse Width Modulation for adjustable speed control and displays the real-time RPM on a LCD screen.

Smart Parking System

Abel James,MS Devanjali

It's a smart Parking System which monitors entry and exit using it sensors to count and alert the filling of parking space

Temperature based industrial sensor acquisition and motor control unit

Thejas J Anil , Muhammad Risfal K P

When the sensor detects that the temperature has exceeded a specific limit, the microcontroller sends a signal to trigger the cooling fan. Once the temperature drops back to a safe range, the system automatically deactivates the actuator to conserve power.

Solar Panel with Sun Position tracking

Akhila PS, S Pranav lal

To achieve the maximum efficiency of the solar panel 3 LDR are fixed to the left, right and centre of sonal panel. The panel rotates to the side where maximum intensity of light is received.

Contactless 360° rotating object detection and counting

Aneena Jipson,Sravan P

Using 360° rotating stepper motor, detect the object around it and shows total count in 7 segment led display

Electronic Voting Machine

Rugma L Satheesh, Sneha K V

This project implements an Electronic Voting Machine using the to securely record votes through push buttons and display status and results on a 16×2 LCD. It includes features like vote locking, start/stop control, and result calculation with winner or tie indication, ensuring a simple and reliable voting process.

Attendance System Using RFID

Akshay M Rahul, Abhinav A R

This project implements an RFID-based attendance system using an 8051/8052 microcontroller, where each student is identified by a unique RFID UID and their attendance is displayed on an LCD. The system ensures accurate tracking by marking each student as present only once and preventing duplicate entries.

Prepaid energy meter

Sandeep Santhosh k,Priyamvada p achuthan

The objective of this project is to simulate a prepaid electricity meter, where each detected pulse reduces the balance, and once the balance reaches zero, the system automatically cuts off.

8051 based 4DoF robotic arm

Akul S Mohan(13), Samil R(58)

8051 based 4DoF robotic arm which uses interrupt driven algorithm to generate 4 pwm signals and uses servo motors to control each joint.

Low Budget Air Quality Index Measurement Device Using 8051

Anand Maheshwar MS, Muhammed Yamin Beck

This is a Budget friendly alternative to the conventional, flamboyant ones available on the market that is available at thrice the cost of production of our project. With the easy sacrifice of SO2 levels and Humidity Measurement, our project measures the PM2.5 level with a precision of ±10ug/m³.

Motion detected environment monitor

Ann Augustian (17) , Arya Devaki (20)

An energy efficient display unit that displays the current time, date, day only when motion is detected. Can me installed in a mirror to make it "smart".

Gas leakage detection using 8051

Devaprabha Manoj , Hashid Aman

Gas Leakage Detection System using 8051 detects the presence of gas using a gas sensor. When leakage is detected, the 8051 microcontroller activates an LED alert with a delay to warn the user. This system helps prevent accidents by providing early detection of gas leaks.

AUTOMATIC WIPER SYSTEM USING 8051

HARINANDANAN S, GOWRISANKARI V S

When there is no rain, the sensor remains dry and the wiper stays OFF. As soon as water droplets fall on the sensor, its conductivity changes, and this change is detected by the microcontroller. The controller then sends a signal to the motor driver, which activates the motor. The motor rotates in toggle motion similar to that of the wiper.

Battleship game using 8051 microcontroller

Sreeraj Rajeevan , Arundhati V

This project is an hardware 8051 based implementation of a board game battleship using an LCD display, matrix keypad and 8x8 led matrix display. For this project we used bit communication similar to that of SPI (bit banging) and state preservation and management system for checking the state of ships whether they are placed/hit

Smart Energy meter with Serial Communication

Aghil Krishna KP, Tessin V George

A 8051 based energy meter which counts input energy pulses, displays it on a LCD screen and serialy communicate the current readings. It is also built with a password reset for billing.
